media.title: Warsaw Conservatory at 1 Okólnik Street — before 1939
media.description: Historical exterior view of the Warsaw Conservatory at 1 Okólnik Street, the venue associated with Eliza Rozenblum’s 1928 performance of three piano pieces by Bronisław Kaper.
media.altText: Black-and-white historical exterior view of the Warsaw Conservatory building at 1 Okólnik Street.
media.rightsNote: Public domain under the Wikimedia Commons PD-Poland assessment: an anonymous photograph published in Poland before 1939 without a copyright notice.
media.publicCaption: The Warsaw Conservatory at 1 Okólnik Street before 1939, associated with the 1928 performance of Kaper’s piano pieces.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; reproduced in Aleksander Janowski, Warszawa, p. 134; Wikimedia Commons.

places.publicNote: Concert hall in the pre-war Warsaw Conservatory building at 1 Okólnik Street, associated with the 1928 press notices on Eliza Rozenblum’s performance of Kaper’s piano pieces. The coordinates indicate the conservatory site, not the exact hall point.
